3. This bail application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S., 2023 has been filed by the applicant- Sahil,
seeking enlargement on bail during trial in connection with Case Crime No. 118 of 2025, under Section 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Agauta, District Bulandshahr.
4.
sentences._hearing_file: Sahil vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: The first information report of the present matter was lodged on 21.05.2025 by the victim against the applicant alleging therein that the applicant is the brother of her friend and used to visit her house and they became close to each other.
sentences._hearing_file: Sahil vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: On 17.12.2020 he established forceful physical relationship with her and assured her of marrying her.
sentences._hearing_file: Sahil vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: The said relationship continued for three years and then it was known to the family members of the house and village and then a complaint was made to the family members of the applicant who stated that once the victim becomes major and the applicant builds his house they would marry her with him.
sentences._hearing_file: Sahil vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: At the said time the victim was aged about 16 years.
sentences._hearing_file: Sahil vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: Subsequently when the victim became major her father went to the house of the applicant for marriage which was refused by them.

sentences.text: The applicant and his family members have ruined her life.

sentences.text: It is submitted that the allegation of rape in the present matter is of 17.12.2020 and the present first information report has been lodged on 21.05.2025 which is after about 4 1/2 years without any plausible explanation regarding the delay.
sentences._hearing_file: Sahil vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 4 September, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is submitted that prior to the present first information report no complaint was made either by the victim or by her family members to any of the authorities or police.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the relationship between the applicant and the victim was a consensual relationship.

sentences.text: While placing paragraph 19 of the affidavit it is submitted that the applicant was on duty in the Indian Army on 17.12.2020 and the allegation therein is of committing rape on the victim is false.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that the victim refused her medical examination when produced before the doctor.
